review_process: Three separately prompted, read-only gpt-5.6-sol/ultra roles, with shared context and parent adjudication. Worker names retain the initial KE70 inquiry after the evidence-supported pivot. No independent human review, calibrated reviewer equivalence or laboratory evidence is implied.

reviews.scope: Exact retained primary XML and visual SI pages2/5/9, all eight R/S rows, 24 parameter values, four factors, methods and source locators; unit-key delta checked.

Four construct-provider JSON pointers and sequence hashes; all source/provider/review pins; eight construct/assay/substrate joins, unit vocabulary, quantities, nulls, factors and both acquisition totals.

Post-RA95.5 screening scope, source-reported versus integrated preference, conflicting kinetics, selection-versus-characterization, exact earlier-design/specimen limits, cleavage-versus-synthesis and causal/benchmark boundaries.

adjudications.objection: A source-reported RA95.5 R preference could either be erased by a null or promoted into a reconciled kinetic label.
adjudications.evidence: SI Table1 page2 RA95.5 S kcat0.17 / KM560uM conflicts with efficiency3.3; factor3.2 differs from16/3.3. Main S3/P12 explicitly reports R preference.
adjudications.decision: Preserve the author-reported direction and all literal quantities; withhold normalized triplet eligibility and integrated direction. Original-to-final reversal does not depend on this intermediate.

adjudications.objection: Printed selectivity factors could be silently replaced by quotients of rounded displayed efficiencies.
adjudications.evidence: All four source factors differ from the displayed-value quotients; footnote b defines R/S efficiency ratio.
adjudications.decision: Retain both as distinct fields; no rounding explanation, exact repaired factor or ratio uncertainty is inferred. The derived quotients are arithmetic, not independent measurements.

adjudications.objection: The documented screening method could be transferred to the earlier design-to-RA95.5 history.
adjudications.evidence: Main Methods/S8/P29 distinguishes the inherited RA95.5; S12/P34 describes the subsequent evolution rounds.
adjudications.decision: After initial source acceptance, adversarial source challenge narrowed the document and current claims to post-RA95.5 rounds and named RA95.5-5/RA95.5-8 characterization. Source objections controlled the final wording.

adjudications.objection: Activity gains or racemic screening could imply preserved S design preference, a causal selection effect, or synthetic product selectivity.
adjudications.evidence: Main S2/P7 reports intended/S-preferred starting context; S5/P20 and SI Table1 report final R preference; S12/P34 is racemic lysate screening, distinct from SI Figure1/main S16 purified enantiopure UV-vis.
adjudications.decision: Permit the construct- and assay-specific preference relation only. No cause, single-residue role, monotonic trajectory, reverse-synthesis selectivity/ee or prospective success rate.

adjudications.objection: Names could transfer the exact earlier design or individual assay specimen identity.
adjudications.evidence: SI Table1 footnote d and existing provider distinguish five surface substitutions in 2013 RA95.0; four source-printed sequence strings bind named study constructs only.
adjudications.decision: Reuse exact provider JSON pointers and hashes without copying strings; leave earlier design and per-assay specimen equivalence unresolved.

adjudications.objection: New chemistry might introduce gratuitous representation variants.
adjudications.evidence: Initial draft used micromolar instead of the established uM token, and new receipt limit/count keys differed from its declared transport version.
adjudications.decision: Standardized eight K_M unit tokens and budget/receipt keys; values unchanged. All three roles accepted the exact resulting pins. No runtime or new validator was added.

adjudications.objection: Failed KE70 full-text routes could become evidence that matched dyad perturbations are absent.
adjudications.evidence: Only exact bibliographic metadata and an author abstract were acquired; all article/SI bodies are errors, challenges or shells.
adjudications.decision: Keep KE70 at access-only accounting, with scientific_result null and dyad evidence unassessed_not_absent. No KE70 science packet or claim entry; stop unchanged failed routes.

blocked_operations: repairing source kinetic values or reconciling the exact four factors
integrated RA95.5 preference or clean kinetic-triplet labels
transferring racemic lysine-mutant sensitivity to enantiopure roles
reverse-synthesis selectivity, yield or product ee
single-site causal or screening-caused reversal claims
earlier design or assay-specimen identity inferred from names
mechanism compilation, protected registry admission, tier upgrade or independent validation
KE70 full-paper absence or dyad qualification from abstract/metadata

Existing RA95/KE59 source annotations and old claim objects remain unchanged. Repository contracts and CI are publication checks, not scientific validation.
